steps.label: dashboard-json
steps.expr: fetch('/host/dashboard').then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(b){return JSON.stringify({mirror:b.mirror, autoDemo:b.autoDemo, viewers:b.viewers, totalLikes:b.totalLikes, totalGifts:b.totalGifts, depth:b.bridge.depth, accepted:b.bridge.accepted, duplicates:b.bridge.duplicates});})
